items.title: Scarecrow Flying a Kite
items.alt: A narrow-faced scarecrow with a long cloth nose wears a blue cap, scarlet jacket and teal scarf while flying a small patchwork kite from a wooden reel.
items.description: A narrow-faced scarecrow with a long cloth nose wears a blue cap, scarlet jacket and teal scarf while flying a small patchwork kite from a wooden reel. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow Watering a Seedling
items.alt: A braided raffia-haired scarecrow in a green sunbonnet, cream floral dress and coral apron pours water onto a small seedling from a galvanized can.
items.description: A braided raffia-haired scarecrow in a green sunbonnet, cream floral dress and coral apron pours water onto a small seedling from a galvanized can. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow and a Crow
items.alt: A cross-stitch-eyed scarecrow in a blue felt hat and saffron poncho sits on a stump while a black crow perches on its outstretched mitten.
items.description: A cross-stitch-eyed scarecrow in a blue felt hat and saffron poncho sits on a stump while a black crow perches on its outstretched mitten. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow Planting a Seedling
items.alt: A sleepy-eyed cloth scarecrow in a coral bucket hat and plum gardening apron lowers a leafy seedling into soil beside a trowel and empty pot.
items.description: A sleepy-eyed cloth scarecrow in a coral bucket hat and plum gardening apron lowers a leafy seedling into soil beside a trowel and empty pot. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow Sorting Apples
items.alt: A rectangular-faced scarecrow in a brown ear-flap cap, navy vest and ochre checked trousers moves a red apple between two wooden crates.

items.title: Scarecrow Tying Corn Stalks
items.alt: A pale cloth scarecrow in a burgundy headscarf and green tunic crouches to tie twine around a bundle of dry corn stalks.
